runners_data.name: Baldomero

races.paceDynamic: Democracy Dilemma will lead unchallenged from the gates, with Regal Envoy, Rhythm N Hooves, All Ways Glamorous, Marty Hopkirk, Baldomero and Rogue Enforcer likely to settle prominently behind. The single front-runner creates a sustainable tempo that won't stretch the field early, allowing the prominent group to travel comfortably. This measured gallop sets up perfectly for hold-up horses like Gaeli, Redorange, Adrestia and Desert Cop to unleash late runs. The race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can benefit from the solid pace and deliver their finishing kicks over this sharp 5f.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the sustainable pace allows closers optimal positioning into the straight
scenarios.body: Democracy Dilemma's uncontested lead creates the perfect scenario for late runners to pick off tired leaders. The hold-up brigade gets the strong pace they need without being caught too far back on this sharp track.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Group Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Democracy Dilemma kicks clear turning in and the prominent runners respond
scenarios.body: The leader's class tells under pressure while the likes of Regal Envoy and All Ways Glamorous benefit from their handy positions. Hold-up horses find the sustained gallop insufficient to reel in the pace-setters.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the handy horses gets first run on Democracy Dilemma approaching the final furlong
scenarios.body: A prominent runner like All Ways Glamorous or Rogue Enforcer times their move perfectly to collar the leader. They get the best of both worlds - a strong pace to aim at but close enough to strike decisively.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Democracy Dilemma goes too slow and the race becomes a sprint from 2f out
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace turns this into a messy dash where any horse with tactical speed can prevail. Form and ratings become less relevant in a slowly-run affair that favours whoever gets first run.

watchPoints.text: Democracy Dilemma must be watched for early fractions - if he goes too fast he'll set up the hold-up horses perfectly
Gaeli's 58-day layoff could be significant despite his retained blinkers and strong recent 5f performances when fresh
All Ways Glamorous has been running well recently but trainer Christopher Mason has 0/4 record in past 14 days
Regal Envoy drops significantly in class with 13lb weight advantage after recent win - prominent position could be crucial
Adrestia returns from 239-day absence despite classy form - watch market confidence for fitness indicators

races.paceDynamic: Withtearsinmyeyes, Tahalel, and Rajwaah will ensure a strong gallop from the start, with Withtearsinmyeyes likely to dominate early given her superior RPR of 95. The pace will be genuine throughout the mile trip as these three have shown consistent front-running tendencies. With sustained pressure up front, the race will develop into a stamina test in the final three furlongs. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses and those with proven finishing kicks who can benefit from the expected pace collapse.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If all three front-runners go too hard early and fade dramatically in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The genuine gallop sets up perfectly for closers who can time their runs, with the pace-setters paying for their aggressive tactics. Hold-up horses with stamina will have ideal conditions to sweep past tired leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Withtearsinmyeyes Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Withtearsinmyeyes can dictate terms and kick clear when the others weaken
scenarios.body: Her superior RPR of 95 and recent good form allows her to control the race from the front and maintain enough in reserve. The strong pace actually suits her stamina-laden pedigree at this mile trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tahalel Times It Right
scenarios.trigger: If Tahalel can sit just off the early pace and benefit from her recent good form
scenarios.body: Her three placings from four starts and good going record allows her to track the early pace before striking. The Richard Hannon stable is in good form and Pat Dobbs can use her tactical speed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Newcomer Quisana Shocks
scenarios.trigger: If the debutant Quisana has inherited the family talent and benefits from a patient ride
scenarios.body: Her outstanding pedigree including Group 1 connections could see her overcome inexperience with natural ability. The strong pace would perfectly suit a horse making a debut with stamina influences.

watchPoints.text: Withtearsinmyeyes sets fractions that are too strong for the field and burns out her rivals including herself in the final furlong
Trelissick gets too far back in running given the Andrew Balding stable's inconsistent form and may need the run after 18 days
Quisana shows greenness on debut that prevents her from capitalizing on what should be ideal pace conditions
Chimes Of Thunder's position tracking the early pace as she could benefit from both the strong gallop and her recent improvement
The three confirmed front-runners create a genuine pace that favors patient tactics and horses with proven finishing kicks

races.paceDynamic: The Flying Seagull will likely lead from the outset with minimal early pressure, as most rivals prefer to settle behind. Isle Of Lismore, Rogue Bullet, Kiss And Run, Jax Edge and General Assembly will track the leader in the early stages, but none are aggressive early types. The pace should be steady rather than frantic through the first half, with the real test coming when the prominent group challenges The Flying Seagull from the 2f marker. This sustainable early pace strongly favours prominent runners and hold-up horses who can finish strongly, as they won't be compromised by overly fast early fractions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If The Flying Seagull sets a manageable tempo without being harassed early
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash late runs, while prominent runners can also kick effectively from good positions. This measured pace allows stamina and class to prevail in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Isle Of Lismore, Rogue Bullet and Kiss And Run press The Flying Seagull from halfway
scenarios.body: The pace lifts significantly in the middle stages, suiting horses that can travel strongly in behind before producing late bursts. Early leaders and prominent runners may pay for their exertions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If The Flying Seagull faces no serious pressure and gets soft sectionals throughout
scenarios.body: The leader maintains enough in reserve to resist late challenges, exploiting the lack of early pace pressure. Prominent runners who track the winner will fill the places.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sprint Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners go too fast chasing The Flying Seagull in the early stages
scenarios.body: The pace becomes unsustainably quick, causing several front-runners to weaken dramatically in the final furlong. Only the strongest stayers and hold-up horses can capitalize.

watchPoints.text: The Flying Seagull could get uncontested lead if prominent runners settle too far back, making him very dangerous
Isle Of Lismore returning after 314-day break with headgear changes suggests major fitness/behavioral concerns
Shavkat and Al Barez both need the pace to develop strongly to show their best hold-up running style
Multiple trainers struggling for winners including Mason, Cook/Bridger and Hobson affecting several fancied runners
Sandscreendeliverd dropping back to 5f after recent 6f efforts could be significant positive or negative depending on pace

races.paceDynamic: Sir Griflet is the only confirmed front-runner in this 7-runner field and will face no early pressure, allowing him to dictate terms through steady fractions over this extended 1m3½f trip. King Of Berkshire and Grey Sands as prominent runners will track close behind, while the hold-up quartet of Oh Yes You Do, Morbeh, Any Which Way and Wardlaw will settle towards the rear. The uncontested lead creates a sustainable pace that builds gradually, leaving plenty of stamina for the final climb. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace without expending early energy.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Sir Griflet maintains his jumping and travels smoothly in front
scenarios.body: The soft lead allows him to quicken when it matters most, while the hold-up horses face an impossible task from too far back on this stiff finish. His recent form may be modest but the tactical advantage is enormous.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If King Of Berkshire or Grey Sands get the perfect trip tracking the leader
scenarios.body: They can strike approaching the final furlong when Sir Griflet's stamina wanes, benefiting from the strong pace but avoiding the pressure of making it. Both have shown better recent form than the leader.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Powers Home
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong and the front-runners tie up
scenarios.body: Any Which Way or Oh Yes You Do could benefit from a truly-run race that sets up their finishing kick. Both have winning form over 10f and the class to capitalise if the race falls apart.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Breaks Through
scenarios.trigger: If Wardlaw shows dramatic improvement on handicap debut after 215 days off
scenarios.body: His progressive juvenile RPRs suggest untapped ability and the gelding operation plus long break could unlock improvement. The realistic handicap mark gives him a genuine chance if sharp enough.

watchPoints.text: Sir Griflet's early position - if he doesn't lead cleanly, the entire race dynamic shifts dramatically
King Of Berkshire's tactical positioning - needs to track the leader closely without getting trapped on the rail
Any Which Way's early alertness after 40-day break - must be sharp enough to overcome likely tactical disadvantage
Wardlaw's fitness levels returning from 215-day absence on handicap debut
Grey Sands maintaining prominent position given her tendency to race keenly

races.paceDynamic: Son Of Man will likely lead uncontested from the gates, with Due To Henry, Naval Command, Siouxfonic and Don Simon settling prominently behind in the early stages. The pace should be steady and sustainable given only one true front runner, allowing the field to stay compact through the middle stages of this 1m3½f contest. In the final three furlongs, this will develop into a staying test where horses need to find extra gear from their position. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can track the pace and kick, as they'll get the ideal tactical position without pressure, while hold-up horses face the risk of the race not developing enough pace to close into.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Son Of Man sets steady fractions and the pace stays manageable
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get perfect positioning to strike turning for home, with the sustained gallop suiting their profiles. Naval Command or Due To Henry can time their challenge perfectly from ideal stalking positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly in the middle stages or Son Of Man goes too fast early
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes strong enough to set up a closing finish, allowing the hold-up horses to unleash late runs. Wisper's class advantage and Sir William's finishing kick become decisive factors in a truly-run race.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Son Of Man gets easy lead and dictates throughout with soft sectionals
scenarios.body: Son Of Man controls the race completely, getting away with slow early fractions before quickening when it matters. The lack of early pace pressure allows him to save energy for a sustained drive to the line.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Son Of Man goes off too slowly and the field bunches up entering the straight
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint finish with positioning crucial in the final two furlongs. The most balanced horses who can adapt to any pace scenario hold the advantage in a rough passage.

races.paceDynamic: Nzuri will take the field along uncontested in front, setting a sustainable pace on this flat 6f course. The real drama unfolds behind him as My Dad Tom, Yachtsman, Chelio, Rosieisme Darling, Arvana Belle and Stolen all want prominent positions, creating a wall of horses tracking the leader. This congestion will intensify 2-3f out when the prominent runners fan wide seeking racing room, creating gaps for hold-up horses. The tactical advantage lies firmly with hold-up runners who can exploit the inevitable traffic problems and capitalize on Nzuri's tendency to fade in the finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses capitalize
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack gets bottled up 2f out as expected
scenarios.body: The traffic jam allows patient riders to thread through gaps or switch wide with cleaner runs. Madman and Corniche Girl benefit most from this chaos with Rossa Ryan and Voikhansky finding the right moment to strike.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent surge succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners gets first run on Nzuri without traffic issues

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Nzuri holds on
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady and the prominent pack neutralizes each other
scenarios.body: The leader's uncontested advantage proves decisive when the chasers spend too much energy fighting for position. His stamina reserves overcome his usual finishing weakness in a messy race behind.

scenarios.label: D

scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and Nzuri stops badly
scenarios.body: A deep closer like Zoulette or Cape Toronada produces a telling late burst when the whole field comes back to them. The combination of generous pace and traffic chaos creates the perfect storm for a big-priced winner.
